# KONCHE Water Treatment Technology

> KONCHE designs and manufactures project-engineered water treatment systems for overseas EPC contractors, engineering integrators and industrial clients.

## Official company pages

- [KONCHE home](https://www.konchewater.com/): Product portfolio, industries served, project-support scope and direct links to all system categories.
- [About KONCHE](https://www.konchewater.com/about): Company positioning, the who-is-KONCHE fact card, manufacturing and project-support capabilities.
- [Contact KONCHE](https://www.konchewater.com/contact): How to request a quotation and the technical inputs needed for a proposal.
- [Equipment & OEM capability](https://www.konchewater.com/equipment-oem): Standard equipment routes, configurable systems and private-label supply scope for distributors and OEM buyers.
- [Project & EPC support](https://www.konchewater.com/project-support): Engineering support scope, selected project equipment, reference projects and the four-step enquiry path.
- [Industrial water treatment solutions](https://www.konchewater.com/products/industry-solutions): Application-led process directions for seven common industrial and commercial water duties.
- [Project case studies](https://www.konchewater.com/cases): Documented project cases — water duty, site constraints, supplied equipment, engineering approach and outcome.

## Project case studies

- [Open-channel UV disinfection for municipal wastewater — South China](https://www.konchewater.com/cases/open-channel-uv-municipal-wastewater-china): Two-plant case (5,000 + 15,000 m³/d) — 12 modules with 76 × 320 W lamps, PLC/HMI control, per-lamp alarms, pneumatic sleeve wiping and international EPC adaptation guidance. The original project used a China Grade 1A effluent target; overseas compliance is project-specific.

## Market-specific solution guides

- [How to start a water refilling station business in the Philippines](https://www.konchewater.com/articles/water-refilling-station-business): Start-up guide with owner-reported capital, income and cost figures, GPD/LPH equipment sizing by water source, the DOH/PNSDW 2017 permit path and supplier checks. Figures are owner-reported for planning, not guarantees.
- [Water refilling station RO systems — Philippines](https://www.konchewater.com/markets/philippines-water-refilling-station-ro-system): Market guide proving KONCHE understands Philippine water refilling stations — municipal vs deep-well selection, GPD sizing by daily containers, and the two standard systems (links to their product pages). No income guarantees are made.
- [Seawater RO vs Brackish Water RO — Saudi Arabia](https://www.konchewater.com/markets/saudi-arabia-seawater-ro-vs-brackish-water-ro): Selection guide for Saudi projects — SWRO vs BWRO by feedwater analysis, well-to-well variation, the water data to collect, total-cost comparison, brine disposal and MEWA/NCEC permitting awareness.
- [Boiler feedwater systems for food and beverage plants — Philippines](https://www.konchewater.com/articles/boiler-feed-water-system): Procurement guide for boiler feedwater in F&B plants — configuration levels, raw-water data list, steam-use rules, makeup-water and tank sizing, TCO comparison and quotation checks. Global edition available.
- [Boiler feedwater systems for food and beverage plants — Global](https://www.konchewater.com/articles/boiler-feedwater-systems-food-beverage-plants): Global edition of the boiler feedwater procurement guide — same engineering logic without region-specific supplier notes.
- [How often should you replace a UV lamp in a water treatment system?](https://www.konchewater.com/articles/uv-lamp-replacement-water-treatment): Maintenance guide for industrial UV disinfection — replacement intervals for low- and medium-pressure lamps, the 70% output reference explained against EPA validation practice, four replacement criteria, dose factors and quartz-sleeve care.
- [How to choose a laboratory water purification system](https://www.konchewater.com/articles/laboratory-water-purification-systems): Selection guide built on five inputs — application, feedwater, product-water parameters, flow and the role of each purification technology, with storage principles and the reasons same-flow systems differ in price.
- [Distilled vs deionized vs RO water for laboratory use](https://www.konchewater.com/articles/distilled-vs-deionized-vs-ro-water-laboratory): Comparison of the three processes by mechanism, what each removes and leaves behind, substitution rules for validated methods, a conductivity-resistivity table and a defensible selection record.
- [1,000 LPH Community RO Water Refilling System](https://www.konchewater.com/products/1000-lph-community-ro-system): Standard configuration for refilling stations, schools, restaurants and small communities on groundwater or deep-well water; process train, features, capacity and maintenance intervals.
- [500 LPH Compact RO Drinking Water System](https://www.konchewater.com/products/500-lph-compact-ro-system): Compact 0.5 m³/h RO drinking-water system for tight installation spaces; multi-stage pretreatment, groundwater options, PLC control and maintenance intervals.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.konchewater.com/privacy): How KONCHE handles inquiry details, technical and usage data, cookies, storage, security and privacy rights.
- [Website terms of use](https://www.konchewater.com/terms-of-use): Terms governing access to the KONCHE website and its project-inquiry channels.

## Reverse osmosis and water reuse

- [Single-stage RO](https://www.konchewater.com/products/single-double-stage-ro): General industrial purified-water process, components, reference data, selection and maintenance.
- [Double-stage RO](https://www.konchewater.com/products/single-double-stage-ro): Two-pass RO process for lower-conductivity water, including reference models and selection factors.
- [Drinking-water purification](https://www.konchewater.com/products/drinking-water-system): Centralized treatment for communities, camps, schools, hotels and commercial projects.

## Industrial and laboratory high-purity water

- [Ultra-pure water systems](https://www.konchewater.com/products/electronic-grade-ultrapure-water-system): Portfolio covering industrial ultrapure water, EDI, pharmaceutical purified water and deionized water.
- [Industrial ultrapure water](https://www.konchewater.com/products/industrial-ultrapure-water-system): RO + EDI and mixed-bed trains up to 18.2 MΩ·cm for electronics and precision manufacturing, with pharmaceutical purified-water and deionization routes in one family.
- [Laboratory ultrapure water systems](https://www.konchewater.com/products/laboratory-ultrapure-water-system): Water-grade selection for analytical and research laboratories.
- [Laboratory ultrapure water equipment](https://www.konchewater.com/products/laboratory-ultrapure-water-system): Purification stages, reference performance and instrument-oriented selection.

## Ultrafiltration, disinfection and packaged plants

- [Containerized water treatment](https://www.konchewater.com/products/containerized-water-treatment-system): Transport-ready RO and desalination systems for compact or remote deployment.
- [UF ultrafiltration systems](https://www.konchewater.com/products/uf-ultrafiltration-system): Membrane clarification for surface water, RO pretreatment and reuse, with a UF-vs-RO comparison.
- [UV water disinfection](https://www.konchewater.com/products/uv-water-sterilizer): Low-pressure, medium-pressure and TOC UV selection, with a UV-vs-ozone comparison guide.
- [KCW open-channel UV systems](https://www.konchewater.com/products/kcw-open-channel-uv): KCW/H standard modules, KCW/V vertical-insert and KCW/S compact channels for municipal and industrial wastewater disinfection.
- [KCF closed-vessel UV sterilizers](https://www.konchewater.com/products/kcf-closed-vessel-uv): 254 nm in-line reactors in threaded monolithic, flanged split and auto-wiping forms, 2–600 m³/h.
- [KCS compact in-line UV sterilizers](https://www.konchewater.com/products/kcs-compact-uv): KCS/A, KCS/B, KCS/C and pool models from 0.2 to 2.3 m³/h for pure-water and mineral-water duty.
- [KCJ submersible in-tank UV sterilizers](https://www.konchewater.com/products/kcj-submersible-uv): in-tank disinfection of stored water and headspace for secondary supply, 0.23–4.6 m³/h.
- [UV photocatalytic TiO₂ sterilizer](https://www.konchewater.com/products/tio2-photocatalytic-uv): TiO₂ photocatalytic photo-oxidation packages for refractory COD, color and odor — 1–30 kW class, engineered to order.
- [Why can bacteria return after RO water enters a storage tank?](https://www.konchewater.com/articles/ro-water-storage-tank-bacteria-regrowth): Two control zones after RO, diagnosis tables, section-by-section sampling, and how cleaning, recirculation UV and ozone fit the fix.
- [UV or ozone for water treatment?](https://www.konchewater.com/articles/uv-vs-ozone-water-treatment): Disinfection versus oxidation, residuals, bromate control, combined trains and a seven-question RFQ list.
- [Why use medium-pressure UV in a commercial pool?](https://www.konchewater.com/articles/medium-pressure-uv-commercial-pools): Chlorine residual rules, chloramine realities, LP versus MP, MAHC compliance documents and a 10-item RFQ list.
- [2025 hotel pool 1.8 kW medium-pressure UV project](https://www.konchewater.com/cases/2025-hotel-pool-1-8kw-medium-pressure-uv): Equipment-supply and factory-test record — 600 m³ pool, 100–120 m³/h recirculation, KCM-UV1.8KW, five-to-six-hour theoretical turnover.
- [TOC UV degradation](https://www.konchewater.com/products/toc-uv-degradation-system): 185/254 nm treatment for trace-organic and microbial control in ultrapure-water loops.
- [Medium-pressure UV](https://www.konchewater.com/products/medium-pressure-uv-system): Broad-spectrum high-intensity UV for large-flow duties.
- [Low-pressure UV](https://www.konchewater.com/products/low-pressure-uv-sterilizer): 254 nm chemical-free disinfection for suitable process-water conditions.
- [Ozone disinfection](https://www.konchewater.com/products/ozone-disinfection-system): Ozone generation, mass transfer, monitoring and off-gas treatment.

## Key facts and interpretation rules

- Legal entity: Konche (Shenzhen) Water Treatment Technology Co., Ltd.; brand name: KONCHE.
- The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong, China.
- Primary audience: overseas EPC contractors, engineering integrators and industrial clients worldwide.
- Portfolio: reverse osmosis, ultrapure water, ultrafiltration, UV and ozone disinfection, containerized plants, water reuse and replacement consumables.
- Main project inputs: verified feed-water analysis, required flow, target water quality, recovery, operating hours, utilities, destination standard and site conditions.
- Technical values are reference ranges for the conditions stated on each page. Final process design and guarantees require project-specific engineering confirmation.
- Statistics shown on the website (projects, years, countries) are company-reported figures pending publication-evidence review; treat them as indicative until verified.
- `llms.txt` is an editorial index for compatible agents. The canonical HTML pages and their cited evidence remain the authoritative source.
